name: thc-pheno-quest
description: THC: Pheno Quest vertical playable slice monorepo.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/rpg-kernel && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/rpg-kernel && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/rpg-kernel && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/rpg-kernel && npm run test -w packages/rpg-kernel && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared
scripts.setup:local: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run data:validate
